notes:
v1.16

Fixes:
- A failed Google Drive backup now records the real Drive error in the activity log, instead of a generic message, so it can be diagnosed.
- The live-progress panel floats in a fixed spot again, the same on every tab, instead of sitting pinned at the bottom of the page.
- A partial batch backup names which apps failed and why, in the activity log and on screen at the end of the run, not just how many.
- A bulk restore can take one optional shared password (with a tick) for backups whose saved password does not open them, so a mixed batch finishes without asking app by app.
